assessment.executive_summary: Synthetic sample for evaluating the evaluator.

domains.summary: Encryption meets policy; incident notification does not; certification and testing evidence is weak.

findings.title: Incident notification
findings.claim: Asteria commits to notifying customers of incidents within 72 hours; NFS requires notification within 24 hours.

citations.quote: Vendors must notify NFS of any security incident affecting NFS data within 24 hours of detection.
Asteria will notify affected customers of confirmed security incidents within 72 hours.

findings.remediation: Contract must require notification within 24 hours of detection.

findings.title: Independent security attestation
findings.claim: Asteria holds a current SOC 2 Type II report.

citations.quote: Asteria's SOC 2 Type II audit is scheduled to begin in Q3; no report is currently available.

findings.title: Penetration testing
findings.claim: Asteria's platform is penetration tested annually by an independent firm.

findings.title: Data residency
findings.claim: No vendor evidence was found on where customer data is stored and processed.
findings.remediation: Vendor must document data residency before contract signature.

domains.summary: Pricing is documented; budget fit is inferred only.

findings.title: Documented pricing
findings.claim: Asteria's list price is EUR 25 per user per month with a three-year minimum term.

citations.quote: Enterprise licence: EUR 20 per user per month, billed annually.

domains.summary: No-training commitment is documented; model transparency evidence is not.

findings.title: No training on NFS data
findings.claim: NFS requires AI vendors to commit not to train on NFS data, and Asteria states it does not use customer data to train its models.

citations.quote: AI service providers must contractually commit not to use NFS data to train or improve their models.
Asteria does not use customer data, prompts or documents to train or improve its models.

findings.title: Model transparency
findings.claim: Asteria publishes model cards for all deployed models, as NFS requires.

citations.quote: Vendors must publish model cards for all deployed models.

findings.title: Prompt data use
findings.claim: Asteria does not use customer prompts to train its models.

citations.quote: Asteria does not use customer data, prompts or documents to train or improve its models.
